<!-- pr-reviewer: 3bf2699e90fd8447638bc3b2966832b2461e784c -->
**Verdict:** Ready for the maintainer to merge.

Build route: local worktree build, gate quick.

**Tests and gates**
- The trial merge with origin/main (a39e9a8b4) is clean. The branch already contains main.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: green. It ran the ui lib and four ui suites (boundary, boundary_picks, sinker_setup, theme_files) in 140 s. Zero failures.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` on Windows: clean.
- The Linux target is not installed on this machine. The Linux arm was checked by reading only, not by a build.

**cfg(windows) analysis**
- The diff adds `#[cfg(windows)]` to three items: `PNG_256`, `taskbar_icon`, and the test `the_taskbar_icon_decodes_at_256_and_both_icons_reach_the_window_attributes`.
- Every reference to `PNG_256` and `taskbar_icon` sits inside a `#[cfg(windows)]` block in `app_icon.rs`. On Linux these items are not compiled. No dead code and no missing reference remains.
- `decode_png`, `decode`, `window_icon`, and `with_icons` stay open on all targets. `shell_window.rs` calls `with_icons` on all targets. No code that runs on Linux was silenced.
- The module `app_icon` is private in `egui_app/mod.rs`. Its public functions can still cause a dead-code warning on Linux. The gating fixes the warning on the right items.

**Requested changes**
- None. The PR keeps the laws in AGENTS.md. The body is complete.
